importantNotes: Domain Policy: Free subdomain hosting (e.g. yourname.vercel.app) is provided for 100% free. If you want a custom domain (.in / .com), you purchase it directly from any registrar and we connect it to your website for free.
You own your domain, Shopify account, and all associated assets.
We provide developer/collaborator access where needed.
Included revisions: 2 rounds before official launch.
Additional changes after launch are charged as per the add-on list.
We do not guarantee sales. Your success depends on your products, pricing, marketing and customer traffic.
All prices are in Indian Rupees (₹).
